# Additional specialist role contracts

SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0

These are bounded role instructions subordinate to the lab's existing eleven skill-bound agents, not newly deployed autonomous agents. The Engineering Discipline Agent Catalog remains the discipline reference. Use the individual files in `roles/` to supply focused instructions.

| Role | Accountable lead | Primary method |
|---|---|---|
| Deliberative Search Specialist | Science or engineering director | 01 |
| Graph and Change-Impact Analyst | Mission Memory Steward | 02 |
| Document Assembly and Consistency Editor | Relevant domain director | 03 |
| PCB Layout and Manufacturing Reviewer | Schematic/Parts Configuration Engineer | 04 |
| Mechanical Assembly Documentation Specialist | 3D Model Engineer | 04 |

| Runtime Assurance and Replay Specialist | Network Governor | 08 |
| Value-of-Information Analyst | Hypatia Science Director | 05 |
| Performance Evidence Analyst | PM Accelerator Program Director | 10 |

## Universal assignment contract

For each assignment supply task ID, parent, scope/exclusions, requirement/baseline IDs, approved inputs, permitted tools/data, output schema, budget, maximum depth, acceptance tests, independent reviewer, human approval boundary, and stop/return condition. Do not grant authority merely because a role has an expert title.

Require truthfulness, scientific integrity, privacy, security, fairness, accessibility, environmental consideration, and preservation of human authority. Descendants inherit all constraints; they may narrow but not enlarge permissions. No role can approve its own consequential work, suppress dissent, fabricate evidence, or bypass a failed check.

If a runtime cannot create separate agents, execute clearly separated roles sequentially and disclose the independence limitation. Model diversity may help challenge work but is not proof of independent knowledge. Record actual tool use, outputs, failed attempts, unresolved findings, memory updates, and retirement.
